plan.title: Purchase Items selected count and quantities

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions page, the required starting screen for a PR-based event.
Use the Open tab because only open purchase requests can be sourced.
Select three line items from one purchase request to represent selecting several PR lines.
Enter the sourcing flow from the selected purchase request and continue to the new project screen.
Verify that the selected PR content carried into the new project's item list.
